mapper.insert: insert into doctor_info(doctorName, gender, department, title, phone, department_id) values (#{doctorName}, #{gender}, #{department}, #{title}, #{phone}, #{departmentId})

doctorName like concat('%', #{doctorName}, '%')

and title like concat('%', #{title}, '%')
